implementation.correction: Login form issues a random five-minute synchronizer token, bound to client IP, kept in bounded in-memory state, and atomically consumed once. Any present non-null Origin must use HTTP and exactly match the already-validated Host authority. Absent or literal null Origin is accepted only with a current token. Tokens are required for same-origin submissions too. Foreign scheme/host/port and missing/replayed/expired/wrong-client tokens are rejected. Existing rate limit, password verifier, session flags, Host/subnet policy and CSP remain.
